summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering under its effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-282552). On November 5, 2026, it signed a securities purchase agreement with certain individual investors to sell 10,300,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.20 per share, for expected gross proceeds of approximately $12.36 million before expenses. No placement agent, underwriter or broker-dealer was engaged, and no commission is payable. Closing is expected on or about November 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds target repayment of promissory notes issued September 10, 2026, plus working capital. Watch dilution and note-repayment execution.
